links.outcome: Change in retrieval MRR@10 after corpus-only ZCA whitening, by model tier
links.effect: Whitening raised MRR@10 for non-retrieval-trained models (+0.066 to +0.304) but lowered it for retrieval-trained models (-0.021 to -0.051).
links.quote: Corpus-only ZCA whitening produced a 2-tier pattern under 5-fold cross-validation: tier 2 non-retrieval-trained models showed positive ΔMRR@10 (+0.066 to +0.304), while tier 1 retrieval-trained models showed negative ΔMRR@10 (-0.021 to -0.051).
